claim: Per PCGamingWiki, the Steam build requires Denuvo whose regular servers include srv01-srv03 and revalidate.wbgames.com, while the Microsoft Store build appears to lack Denuvo; GOG sells a DRM-free version.
evidence: PCGW refcheck notes the MS Store build made no connection to srv01-srv03 or revalidate.wbgames.com.
verification_method: Read PCGamingWiki wikitext via MediaWiki API on 2026-10-23.
limitations: Community wiki; the MS Store observation is from 2019 and based on heuristics. Switching storefront is outside project scope (target is the Steam build).
next_experiment: During isolated runtime tests later, observe (do not block blindly) DNS requests to Denuvo/WB hosts to understand offline behaviour; never alter DRM.
